title: Conditional research-guidance cycle from synthesis through evidence revision
placement: An optional connection in the existing methods layer. It reuses D53 preparation records, D51 task continuity, D52 resource-gap control, plan sealing, statistical-unit guidance, biological explanation, and real producer-consumer interfaces.
problem: A literature synthesis or execution result must be explained in terms a person can use, discussed where goals or constraints need human direction, and connected to the next data, plan, execution, and evidence update. A review can also be a complete independent deliverable.
decision: Use six conditional stages. A prepared brief is ready to discuss; only an actual discussion source can support a joint direction choice. Routine work covered by existing authorization may continue without creating an unnecessary human gate.

version_families.alignment_rule: Each record family maintains its own version sequence and path. References identify the version used; numeric version values do not have to match across families.
version_families.stage_only_transition: When research scope and D51 task binding are unchanged, retain the existing discussion and first-plan version and path; a stage change alone does not create a new version in those families.

stage_contract.input: D53 source-ledger and evidence-map versions, coverage snapshot, and current research purpose. Include cycle.synthesis.time_scope with study_target=current by default; same_historical_window records its cutoff/as_of and reason.
stage_contract.output: A readable synthesis connecting objects, measurements, use, method motivations, conditional consensus, open disagreements, competing explanations, candidate questions, methods, and remaining uncertainty.

stage_contract.input: The synthesis brief, current options and recommendation, evidence locations, and decision questions.
stage_contract.output: A separate direction-discussion record with actual source, date, participant, human goals or constraints, and discussion state. A prepared brief is ready-to-discuss.
stage_contract.pending_behavior: If a new human choice is required and still pending, report waiting_human.

stage_contract.input: A completed discussion when required, current authorization, D53 evidence-map references, and valid options.
stage_contract.output: A reasoned selected option, human source when required, selected question and method references, and the next unmet gate.

stage_contract.input: The selected question, findings and method from the referenced D53 evidence-map version, and the direction decision.
stage_contract.output: D53 study bridge, D51 study/iteration/task context, data and evaluation requirements, resource-gap disposition, first-plan version, required audit, and first real artifact seam.
conditions: In the Harness-native workflow, the D53 study-bridge fields, D51 task identities, plan version and standard archived plan-seal ACK are consistent.

For mode=historical_window and study_target=current, refresh_before_study=true and a readable refresh_record_ref are required; targeted retrieval or a reasoned applicability review can satisfy the refresh without a new-paper quota.
For study_target=same_historical_window, historical_scope_reason and as_of or the original cutoff are required; window-external sources are not required.
Equivalent platform records may be handled by the matching adapter or human review.

stage_contract.input: The current bound task, sealed plan, declared producer-consumer seam, actual bounded-run receipt, and evaluation design.
stage_contract.output: References to an actual execution with PID, cwd and current task binding, plus evaluation, evidence and delivery artifacts. The same task-bound run may continue to be referenced during evidence revision.
stage_contract.run_reuse_rule: A change of cycle stage or cycle-record version alone does not require a new run when scope and D51 task binding remain unchanged.
stage_contract.checker_boundary: Check existence and identity relationships; research interpretation remains with the scientific reviewer.

stage_contract.input: Observed outputs and evaluation artifacts compared with the current plan, units, denominator and predeclared criteria.
stage_contract.output: A versioned update to claims, uncertainty, route, or next gate, with links to the evidence and prior decision.
stage_contract.discussion_trigger: A material change in research meaning, budget boundary, or route priority returns the result to explanation and human discussion before the next direction choice.
stage_contract.version_rule: Research-cycle, source-ledger, evidence-map, discussion and first-plan versions are independent record families. After results, scope, inclusion, cleaning, split or selection changes use a new applicable plan/version and D51 task binding where scope, objective or iteration changes; preserve the original first plan and protected evaluation set.
stage_contract.run_reuse_rule: The evidence revision for the same study may reference the same actual run used during execution_evaluation; stage progression does not trigger a rerun.
stage_contract.task_binding_rule: When research scope, objective or iteration changes, validate the new current D51 binding. A run whose recorded task identity does not match the current binding remains historical evidence and cannot satisfy current-task execution evidence.

decision_view.role: A serialization view of the existing Decision object; it adds no domain object.
decision_view.evidence_support: Provide evidence_refs or observed_findings_ref to support the recorded action; rationale text alone does not identify the evidence.
decision_view.revision_link: revise creates a new cycle version whose previous_version points to the current version.
decision_view.other_actions: keep, narrow, defer, and stop may close the current cycle or leave a stated continuation action; they do not require a new cycle version.

explanation_elements: research object, measured quantity and intended use
a relationship map explaining why methods evolved and which need each method addresses
open disagreements and one or two competing explanations
usually two or three feasible directions and a recommendation; one direction is acceptable when its constraints are explained
required data and information, cost, owner, alternatives, and conditions that would change the recommendation
one or two concrete questions for the person to decide
human_guidance.evidence_language: Separate author-reported findings, cross-source synthesis, and working hypotheses. Describe novelty and coverage within the recorded search scope.
requires_human_choice_when: research objective or intended use changes
a measurement essential to the claim is missing
a diagnostic reaches its declared budget boundary
the synthesis reveals a choice outside the existing authorization
human_guidance.existing_authorization: Routine bounded repairs and continuation within the current objective may proceed under the existing task context. If requires_human_choice is true, existing_authorization cannot substitute for a real current discussion and choice.
human_guidance.choice_source: A direction choice requires a valid option and a readable source for the actual human selection whenever the human-choice condition applies. Preparation alone records no agreement.

routing.resource_gaps: Use D52 only when a missing source, identity relation, measurement, coverage, or evaluation input can change the selected claim or use.
routing.task_restoration: Use D51 to bind study_id, iteration_id, active entry, work root, current phase and next unmet gate; restore and delivery checks refer to the same current task context.
routing.versioning_policy: Research-cycle, source-ledger, evidence-map, direction-discussion and first-plan records are distinct version families. A stage-only transition with unchanged research scope and D51 task binding retains the existing discussion and first-plan version/path. References record the exact family and version used; cross-family version numbers are not synchronized.
routing.historical_review: A historical review may seed a new current question or support reconstruction of the same historical window. For current work, the default time scope is current and a readable refresh record is required before data_and_plan; targeted retrieval or a reasoned applicability review may supply it without a paper-count target. For same_historical_window, retain the original cutoff/as_of and reason; window-external sources are optional.

status_meanings.ready: Declared stage inputs, references and required decision records meet structural conditions; scientific adequacy is reviewed separately.
status_meanings.waiting_human: A required genuine human choice has not yet been recorded.
status_meanings.needs_work: A referenced input, identity, path, stage prerequisite or required link is missing or inconsistent.

record_and_check_interface.reference_rules: Every record reference is a root-relative path or null. Resolve it from the supplied work root; reject paths that escape the root. Parse each file and calculate its identity from the same read.
record_and_check_interface.direction_binding: Direction choice and later stages require a valid selected option mapped to question and method identities in the referenced D53 evidence-map version.
record_and_check_interface.study_binding: For the Harness-native workflow, data_and_plan checks D53 study-bridge fields and consistent D51 task identities, plan version and standard archived plan-seal ACK. Equivalent task and decision records from an existing platform use its adapter or human review.
record_and_check_interface.execution_binding: For the Harness-native workflow, execution_evaluation checks a real bounded run with PID, cwd and current D51 task binding, and readable evaluation/evidence/delivery references. The same actual run may be referenced from execution_evaluation into evidence_revision when the study scope and task binding remain unchanged; a cycle-version or stage change alone does not require another run. When scope, objective or iteration changes, validate the new D51 binding and do not use a run with a mismatched task identity as current execution evidence. Equivalent run evidence from another platform uses its adapter or human review.
record_and_check_interface.science_boundary: scientific_acceptance is always not_assessed by the structural checker.
record_and_check_interface.revision_evidence_link: A decision carries evidence_refs or observed_findings_ref; revise points to a new cycle version whose previous_version identifies the current version.
record_and_check_interface.decision_model_note: Serialization view of the existing Decision; no new top-level research object.
record_and_check_interface.revision_decision_previous_version_requi: action=revise; the new cycle version previous_version points to the current version.

revision_decision_action_semantics.keep: close or continue the current cycle under the current direction
revision_decision_action_semantics.revise: create a new cycle version whose previous_version points to the current version
revision_decision_action_semantics.narrow: close or continue with a narrower claim or scope
revision_decision_action_semantics.defer: close or leave a stated continuation action
revision_decision_action_semantics.stop: close the current branch or leave an explicit recovery condition

native_checker_support_scope.task_and_decision: D51 task-context and existing Decision serialization view
native_checker_support_scope.execution: Harness bounded-run receipt with PID, cwd and current task binding
native_checker_support_scope.other_platforms: Equivalent existing platforms remain valid. Use their native records with an appropriate adapter or human review; the native checker does not require conversion to the Harness-native seal or runner.

time_scope_conditional_fields.refresh_record_ref: required and readable when a current-target historical window reaches data_and_plan with refresh_before_study=true; a current-target historical window at data_and_plan cannot proceed without it

historical_window_current_target.valid_refresh: targeted evidence retrieval or a reasoned applicability review explaining why existing evidence still applies

record_and_check_interface.revision_decision_evidence_requirement: At least one evidence_refs entry or a readable observed_findings_ref supports the action.

direction_intents.study: Non-empty question and method IDs resolve to the evidence map and align with one another.
direction_intents.nonstudy: Question/method arrays may be empty; any supplied IDs still resolve. Keep reasons, alternatives, dependencies and change conditions.
direction_intents.next_stage: Only a selected study intent enters data_and_plan or later computational stages; other intents can independently close or continue the review route.

version_families.cycle: Coordination record version, independent of the versions of referenced inputs.
version_families.discussion: Retain the original real discussion/version during same-scope stage advancement.
version_families.source_and_evidence: Use the referenced material own version labels and record byte identities; do not derive them from the cycle version.
version_families.first_plan: Keep the actual sealed plan/version while stage records advance. New scope/plan versions follow the original seal and D51 continuity rules.

record_and_check_interface.same_task_evidence_reuse: Evaluation and evidence revision may use the same actual run bound to the same D51 task/iteration/context. A stage-record update alone does not require rerunning. Changed task identity, scope or plan requires appropriate new task binding; retained historical evidence stays explicitly historical.
record_and_check_interface.native_adapter_scope: The first checker consumes native D53 source/evidence/bridge, D51 task/context/delivery, standard plan seals and successful bounded-run completion evidence. Other platform formats and failed/incomplete computational paths remain with their explicit adapter or human review; a structural needs_work report is not a direction to rerun.

example_boundary: The existing D53 Splice preparation example may be used as a retrospective input. It is not a new discussion, experiment, mapping, or scientific validation. Fixtures used by the checker are synthetic program data.

implementation_and_acceptance.actual_material_walkthrough: Prepared Splice brief -> ready; pending actual choice -> waiting_human. No human choice was manufactured.
implementation_and_acceptance.documentation_validation: Current documentation and inventory receipt is maintained at repository machine/history/documentation-refresh.json.

limits: A completed discussion record captures an actual human input, but the reasonableness of a choice is reviewed in its research context.
Structural and identity checks do not validate the synthesis, data semantics, causal interpretation, or scientific conclusion.
Not every research task needs all six stages; route through only the stages required by its decision and authorization.
The native checker supports D51/D53 records, the Harness standard archived seal, and bounded-run receipts; other equivalent platforms remain valid through an appropriate adapter or human review.
